raw_message.reasoning:
Wait, for `{^3}`, the original pattern was `.{3,}?` which is lazy but requires at least 3 characters. With padding on both sides (center alignment), it would match exactly 3 characters because:
- The first fill group ` *` can consume leading spaces
- The main group matches minimum 3 non-space chars
- The trailing fill group consumes remaining spaces

But with my change to `[^ ]{3,}?`, this becomes greedy and will match ALL non-space characters up to a space. So for "hello world", it would match "hello" instead of "hel".

This is wrong for fixed-width fields. Let me reconsider...
